items.name: Cooking oil residue on chicken
items.preparation: implied light oil from grilling, not directly visible

scale_cues: Square white dinner plate assumed ~26 cm across; cherry tomatoes (~2.5-3 cm, ~9 g each) used as an internal size reference for the chicken cubes (~1.5-2.5 cm); chicken pile covers roughly a quarter of the plate in mostly a single to double layer.
assumptions: Chicken is skinless breast meat, cooked, at ~165 kcal and 31 g protein per 100 g
Six cherry/grape tomatoes at ~9 g each
No sauce or dressing visible; only a small amount of cooking oil assumed
Plate size assumed as standard ~26 cm square dinner plate
Chicken pile is mostly one to two layers deep
